index.name: SGM Studios - Suno AI Workflow Suite
index.description: Six-script pipeline for importing, organizing, and mastering Suno AI audio in REAPER. Import ZIP files, rename/categorize tracks, detect BPM, split at structural boundaries, normalize loudness, and align stems — end to end, no coding required.

reapack.name: Suno_ZIP_Importer
reapack.desc: Import a Suno AI ZIP file: unzip, parse metadata, create color-coded session with lyrics markers

version.author: Scott Mills
version.changelog: + ImGui-based single-window workflow + Structural markers generated from lyrics timestamps + Lyrics written to REAPER Project Notes

reapack.name: Suno_01_MetadataOrganizer
reapack.desc: Scan tracks, parse Suno AI filenames, rename tracks, assign colors, and tag metadata

version.author: Scott Mills
version.changelog: + Fix Suno ID detection: replace invalid Lua {8,32} pattern with validated %%w+ match + Fix stem label casing: remove redundant :upper() that prevented title-case display

reapack.name: Suno_02_TempoMapper
reapack.desc: Analyse a selected Suno audio item, estimate BPM, and insert a REAPER tempo marker

version.author: Scott Mills
version.changelog: + Initial release: RMS-onset BPM detection + guard marker + manual override

reapack.name: Suno_03_DynamicSplitter
reapack.desc: Split Suno audio items at structural boundaries (verse/chorus/bridge) using energy contrast

version.author: Scott Mills
version.changelog: + Initial release: long-window energy contrast structural detection + right-to-left splitting

reapack.name: Suno_04_LoudnessMaster
reapack.desc: Batch-normalise selected Suno items to a target integrated loudness level

version.author: Scott Mills
version.changelog: + Initial release: peak-RMS loudness measurement + batch normalisation to target LUFS

reapack.name: Suno_05_StemAligner
reapack.desc: Organise third-party stem separations (UVR5, Demucs, Fadr) into a mix-ready layout

version.author: Scott Mills
version.changelog: + Fix Suno ID stripping: replace invalid Lua {8,32} pattern with validated %%w+ match

reapack.name: SGM SunoWorkflow Bundle
reapack.desc: SGM Studios Suno AI Workflow Suite: five-script pipeline for importing and preparing Suno AI tracks

version.author: Scott Mills
version.changelog: + Suno_01_MetadataOrganizer 1.0.1: fix Suno ID detection + stem label casing + Suno_05_StemAligner 1.0.1: fix Suno ID stripping pattern
